record.question: Which of the following blood component must be prepared within 8 hours after phlebotomy?
record.explanation: Answer A: Fresh frozen plasma. FFP must be separated from red cells and frozen within 8 hours of collection under the cited collection-system directions; cryoprecipitate is prepared later from frozen plasma. Reference: https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/getFile.cfm?setid=d763511e-f1a7-4014-94b9-f7ad8f023ff4&type=pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
